settings.treeSitterLanguages.label: Tree-sitter languages

settings.indexStorageBackend.hint: json (default) or sqlite sidecar for merkle on large repos (Node 22+).
settings.indexSqliteMinFiles.label: SQLite min fileCount
settings.indexSqliteMinFiles.hint: Persist merkle to index.sqlite when fileCount ≥ this (backend=sqlite).
